title: THE BOARDING WINDOW READS EXTRACT IN PROGRESS
why: His words of 2026-10-03, given mid-raid: EXTRACT NOW! becomes EXTRACT IN PROGRESS! It is the banner above the belt while the ship sits in the ring, the badge on the ring itself and the line under the ring on the sector map, all three from the same words. The letter and the seconds left stay as they were.
now: The extraction banner now reads EXTRACT IN PROGRESS! with the ring letter and the seconds left.
